title: Horizontal Acceleration Magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the horizontal acceleration during the curved phase, obtaining 100 m/s².

title: Vertical Acceleration Magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the vertical acceleration during the curved phase, obtaining 0 m/s².

title: Total Flight Time
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the total time from launch to impact, obtaining 25 s.

title: Thrust Force Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Newton's second law to find the constant thrust force from the initial vertical acceleration.

title: Initial Phase Kinematics
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly use kinematic equations to find the time and final velocity for the initial vertical ascent to 5000 m.

title: Curved Phase Force Resolution
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly resolve the thrust force into horizontal and vertical components using the given cosine value.

title: Curved Phase Vertical Motion
description: Important Criteria: The student must recognize that the vertical acceleration is zero during the curved phase, leading to uniform vertical motion.

title: Sign or Direction Error
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly assigns signs to accelerations or velocities, or misinterprets the direction of the thrust force components.

title: Unit Inconsistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student uses inconsistent units (e.g., mixing g=10 and g=9.8) or omits units in final answers.
